propositions: A committed operational script using stock git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) must be built and proven on a scratch unfiltered clone before publication, preserving DAG topology and commit/merge counts while removing .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes.
The script must dynamically derive the re-add set from git ls-tree rather than hardcoded lists, and parse data blocks by byte length to handle commit messages starting with git commands.
Pre-rewrite, the harness must assert .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ is absent from old-tip; post-rewrite, no commit shall touch .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ and final tree must byte-match the original.
The script must refuse execution on partial (blob:none) clones with a nonzero exit and operator-readable remedy, and must never perform remote push operations during dry-run.
Rewritten branch pack size must not exceed 150 MB; representative writer push must increase incremental size-pack by less than 1 MB and result in non-ancestor relationship with old-tip.
